item.title: ‘VRChat’ Breaks All-Time Concurrent User Record with Japanese Anime Concert
item.description: VRChat announced it just topped its all-time user peak, bringing in over 150,000 concurrent users to attend a Japanese language concert. VRChat Community Head ‘Tupper’ confirmed on X that the social VR platform hit a new all-time high of 156,716 concurrent users over the weekend.
